about.title: One partner from idea to launch — and after.
about.body: Soft Step is a licensed software company that helps businesses go online with clear, dependable products: company websites, online shops, mobile apps, and the systems behind them. We plan, build, and hand over software your staff and customers can actually use — with ongoing support when you need it.

indoform.name: IndoForm — WhatsApp shop for small businesses
indoform.tagline: Open a shop, share one link, get orders on WhatsApp.
indoform.desc: Soft Step’s own platform for Indonesian small businesses (UMKM): create a storefront, share a private link, and receive orders on WhatsApp — with local QRIS payments, a seller dashboard, and no platform commission.
indoform.role: Full build of Soft Step’s own shopping platform: storefront, seller tools, payments, and the systems behind them.
features: Private shareable shop link for each seller
Orders via WhatsApp in about 10 seconds
Seller dashboard for orders and tracking
0% platform fee — sellers keep their revenue

valleyOrder.name: Valley Order
valleyOrder.tagline: The system behind a multi-sided delivery service.
valleyOrder.desc: Soft Step built the core software for a delivery marketplace used by customers, service providers, drivers (captains), and admins — including login, pricing, notifications, order steps, and live tracking.
valleyOrder.role: Designed and delivered the backend systems that power the marketplace day to day.
features: Separate experiences for customer, provider, captain, and admin
